items.desc_en: The order comes after election officials received letters demanding they set aside the ballots of possible non-citizen voters.
items.desc_zh: 该命令是在选举官员收到要求他们搁置可能的非公民选民选票的信件后发布的。

items.desc_en: It comes amid growing protests over a voter roll revision exercise feared to leave 130 million voters off rolls.

items.title_en: Trump defamation suit against Murdoch, WSJ over Epstein letter dismissed with prejudice

items.desc_zh: 通过有偏见地驳回诉讼，特朗普无法向地区法院提交另一份修改后的版本。特朗普的法律团队表示，总统计划上诉。
